section.content: The invention provides a semiconductor integrated circuit capable of outputting a signal whose level changes in response to an input signal even though the input common level of the input signal fluctuates. This semiconductor integrated circuit is provided with a transistor MP1 for making current flow to a node N1 from a power supply voltage VDD, a transistor MP2 for making current flow to a ground voltage GND from the node N1, an inverter IN1 for driving the node N1 in response to the input signal, and an inverter IN3 for driving a node N2 in response to the voltage of the node N1.
本发明的课题是，获得即使输入信号的输入公共电平发生变动，也能输出其电平随输入信号而变化的信号的半导体集成电路。具有使电流从电源电压VDD流向节点N1的晶体管MP1、使电流从节点N1流向接地电压GND的晶体管MP2、响应于输入信号驱动节点N1的倒相器IN1、以及响应于节点N1的电压驱动节点N2的倒相器IN3。

Semiconductor integrated circuit[detailed description of the invention]

[technical field that the present invention belongs to]

The present invention relates to the semiconductor integrated circuit of amplification input signal.

[existing technology]

Fig. 1 is the differential amplifier of knowing so far.This differential amplifier is with the current mirror that is made of pMOS transistor T P1, the TP2 such differential amplifier as load, it accepts input signal A, B respectively with the gate electrode of nMOS transistor T N1, TN2, and the signal that the difference voltage of this input signal has been amplified from the connected node N of pMOS transistor T P2 and nMOS transistor T N2 output.Fixing bias voltage is applied on the gate electrode as the nMOS transistor T N3 of constant-current source.

Such differential amplifier also can be used as input buffer and uses.With reference to Fig. 2, on semiconductor chip 3, form the input buffer 4 that the differential amplifier by Fig. 1 constitutes, input buffer 4 accepts from the signal A that is installed in output buffer 2 output on the other semiconductor chip 1 respectively via transmission lines 5,6 and be the signal B of its reverse signal, and the main circuit that the output signal supply has been formed in same semiconductor chip 3.Signal A, B offer the gate electrode of MOS transistor TN1, TN2 respectively.

[inventing problem to be solved]

When existing differential amplifier was applied to the input buffer 4 of Fig. 2, the common electrical of the input signal that its is accepted was looked squarely relative output buffer 2 and different.So-called common level means the maximum voltage VH0 of amplitude of input signal and the centered level Vc (Vc=(VH0+VL0)/2) of minimum voltage VL0.But even the input signal of same-amplitude, common level one reduces, and the gate terminal of MOS transistor TN1, TN2 just becomes to the voltage of separately source electrode end points and is difficult to surpass the threshold voltage of self.This can become, and to produce signal output waveform messy, and for example output signal is to the change reason of such problem of the duty ratio of input signal.And then, if common level low make MOS transistor TN1, TN2 gate terminal the voltage of separately source electrode end points is no more than threshold voltage fully, differential amplifier is not just worked so.

Therefore, the objective of the invention is to,, also can export the semiconductor integrated circuit of the signal that its level changes with input signal even a kind of common level change of input signal is provided.

[solving the method for problem]

Semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention makes electric current flow to the 1st element of the 1st node and make electric current flow to the 2nd element of the 2nd pressure-wire apply the 2nd voltage from the 1st node from the pressure-wire that applies the 1st voltage by means of having, and sets the bias voltage of appointment.

Semiconductor integrated circuit at the 1st phase inverter that the direction opposite with the change in voltage of input signal changes, shows the voltage of the 1st node being setovered to the direction of the bias voltage of the common level of setting input signal by means of the voltage that has that its output connects with the 1st node and make the 1st node in response to the change in voltage of input signal.

Semiconductor integrated circuit and then connect with the 2nd node, make 2nd phase inverter of the voltage of the 2nd node in the direction variation opposite with the change in voltage of the 1st node in response to the change in voltage of the 1st node by means of having its output makes amplitude be exaggerated at the signal of the common level that is biased.In view of the above, even the common level change of input signal also can be exported the signal in response to this input signal.

Particularly, the 1st phase inverter have be connected between the 3rd pressure-wire that applies the 1st voltage and the 1st node, make electric current from the 3rd pressure-wire flow to the 3rd element of the 1st node and be connected the 4th pressure-wire that applies the 2nd voltage and the 1st node between, make electric current flow to the 4th element of the 4th pressure-wire from the 1st node.At this moment, if make the 1st and the 2nd element always have electric current to flow through, and the electric current of the 1st and the 2nd element of flowing through is increased respectively than the electric current of the 3rd and the 4th element of flowing through, then the variable scope of the common level of input signal just increases.

Semiconductor integrated circuit and then the change in voltage that has in response to another input signal make 3rd phase inverter of the voltage of the 2nd node in the direction variation opposite with the change in voltage of another input signal.If another input signal is contrary logical relation to input signal, then the 3rd phase inverter has the effect of the change in voltage of quickening the 1st node.

The 2nd phase inverter comprises the MOS transistor with the drain terminal that is connected with the 2nd node and the gate terminal that is connected with node N1.The 3rd phase inverter comprises the MOS transistor that has the drain terminal that is connected with the 2nd node and accept the gate terminal of another input signal.Driving force by means of the MOS transistor that makes the 3rd phase inverter reduces than the 2nd phase inverter, but the mobility scale of the common level of input signal is increased.

Semiconductor integrated circuit and then have be connected between the power line of accepting supply voltage and the 1st pressure-wire, make electric current flow to the 3rd element of the 1st pressure-wire from power line, the 1st pressure-wire and the 1st and the 2nd phase inverter link together.Can expect to reduce power consumption by being adjusted at the magnitude of current that flows through on the 3rd element.Equally, semiconductor integrated circuit and then have be connected between the earth connection of accepting earthed voltage and the 2nd pressure-wire, make electric current flow to the 4th element of earth connection from the 2nd pressure-wire, the 2nd pressure-wire and the 1st and the 2nd phase inverter link together.Can expect to reduce power consumption by being adjusted at the magnitude of current that flows through on the 4th element.

The 1st phase inverter comprises p channel-type the 1st transistor that for example has source electrode end points, the drain terminal that is connected with the 1st node of accepting the 1st voltage and the gate terminal of accepting input signal, and n channel-type the 2nd transistor with source electrode end points, the drain terminal that is connected with the 1st node of accepting the 2nd voltage and the gate terminal of accepting input signal.In addition, the 2nd phase inverter also can comprise the source electrode end points that for example has acceptance the 1st voltage, p channel-type the 3rd MOS transistor of drain terminal that is connected with the 2nd node and the gate terminal that is connected with the 1st node, and has the source electrode end points of accepting the 2nd voltage, n channel-type the 4th MOS transistor of drain terminal that is connected with the 2nd node and the gate terminal that is connected with the 1st node.

In addition, the 3rd phase inverter also can comprise p channel-type the 5th MOS transistor that for example has source electrode end points, the drain terminal that is connected with the 2nd node of accepting the 1st voltage and the gate terminal of accepting another input signal, and have the source electrode end points of acceptance the 2nd voltage, the drain terminal that is connected with the 2nd node and with n channel-type the 6th MOS transistor of the gate terminal of accepting another input signal.

Because the component number that is connected in series between 2 pressure-wires that apply the 1st and the 2nd voltage reduces, so can lower voltage.

The 1st element comprises the 7th MOS transistor that is connected between the 1st pressure-wire and the 1st node, and the 2nd element comprises the 8th MOS transistor that is connected between the 1st node and the 2nd pressure-wire.At this moment, the driving force of the 1st and the 2nd MOS transistor is reduced respectively than the 7th and the 8th MOS transistor.When above-mentioned the 3rd phase inverter is set, the driving force of the 5th and the 6th MOS transistor is reduced respectively than the 3rd and the 4th MOS transistor.In view of the above, but the mobility scale of the common level of input signal increase.

On the other hand, when making the 3rd with the 7th and the 8th MOS transistor identical degree to be arranged respectively with the driving force of the 4th MOS transistor, the voltage amplification that the 2nd phase inverter will be biased on the 1st node gets very big.

As the 7th and the 8th MOS transistor is made p channel-type and n channel type MOS transistor respectively, then the number of p channel-type and each MOS transistor of n channel-type becomes identical.

Preferably, its drain terminal and gate terminal are coupled together to the 7th and the 8th MOS transistor each.

And then, semiconductor integrated circuit comprise be connected between the power line of accepting supply voltage and the 1st pressure-wire, make electric current flow to the 3rd element of the 1st pressure-wire from power line, and be connected between the earth connection of accepting earthed voltage and the 2nd pressure-wire, make electric current flow to the 4th element of earth connection at least one from the 2nd pressure-wire.The 1st pressure-wire will link together with the source electrode end points of the 1st and the 3rd MOS transistor at least.The 2nd pressure-wire will link together with the source electrode end points of the 2nd and the 4th MOS transistor at least.

And then the 1st also can be connected with the source electrode end points of the 6th MOS transistor with the 5th respectively with the 2nd pressure-wire.
